lines.text: Meet Sightline: captions that wait for you.
Built for deaf and hard-of-hearing students.
Upload the slides before class. Sightline learns the lecture's jargon, so captions spell it right.
As the teacher speaks, captions appear live. Spoken maths becomes real formulas, and the slides follow along on their own.
Look up at the board, and the captions pause. Look back, and every line you missed is highlighted.
It works both ways. The student fingerspells a question,
Could you please repeat the formula?
lines.note: the laptop speaking for the student

lines.text: and the teacher answers, right in the captions.
End the lecture, and Sightline saves the recording and writes your notes, formulas included.
Sightline. Captions that wait for you.
